research.methodology: Public-source research only. Course and municipal websites were preferred. Hole shape is classified only when official text states a dogleg or straight layout; otherwise it is unknown. No played-tee yardages were inferred. Diagram-only conclusions would be labeled map-inference, but the included hole claims are explicit text except where noted in limitations.

courses.name: Northlands Golf Course
courses.overview: A Les Furber-designed public course carved through coastal rainforest at the foot of Mt. Seymour, with holes framed by old-growth trees.

courses.limitations: No official public hole guide or labeled course map was found. The scorecard documents special drop-area rules for holes 6 and 8, but other hole geometry, elevation, and hazards remain unavailable. The official site also notes five holes are always cart-path-only due to terrain without identifying them.

courses.name: Langara Golf Course
courses.overview: A walkable classic course with curved, narrow tree-lined fairways and large rolling greens.
courses.limitations: The official page provides course-level characteristics and the scorecard provides par and yardage data, but no reliable official hole-by-hole geometry or hazard descriptions were found.

courses.name: Fraserview Golf Course
